title: Polarized vs. Threshold Training Intensity Distribution on Endurance Sport Performance: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
publisher: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
claims: The database search yielded 329 results; four studies met the inclusion criteria for qualitative analysis and three for meta-analysis.
Two of the four included studies scored 4/10 on the PEDro scale and two scored 5/10.
The pooled time-trial result showed a moderate effect favoring polarized over threshold training (ES = -0.66; 95% CI -1.17 to -0.15).
The authors concluded that polarized training may lead to greater improvement in endurance sport performance than threshold training, based on a small evidence base.

摘要：合并 TT 效应 ES −0.66（95% CI −1.17 至 −0.15），偏向极化。
摘要：作者称极化可能带来更大耐力表现改善，但证据基础小。
